verdict.rationale: Runway documents Aleph 2.0 as "Precise video editing" and describes an AI video editor that edits real footage with generative models, including a video_to_video mode. A hands-on user also reported near-seamless masks that tracked changing poses, which supports isolating an element. However, no evidence explicitly shows replacing or restyling a specific object while the rest of the frame stays untouched. Missing for 10: explicit docs on element-level replace/restyle, evidence that the unedited regions are preserved, independent hands-on corroboration of targeted generative edits.
